For the 2026 estimate, the EUR 287 000 (included in EUR 157 792 251) are subject to the approval of the Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL on plants obtained by certain new genomic techniques and their food and feed and amending Regulation (EU) 2017/625. Without these funds, the amount totals EUR 157 505 251.
For the 2025 estimate, the EUR 81 000 (included in EUR 147 038 844) were subject to the approval of the Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL on plants obtained by certain new genomic techniques and their food and feed, and amending Regulation (EU) 2017/625 This approval did not occur therefore the revised estimate for 2025 amounts to EUR 146 957 845.
( 2 )
For the 2026 estimate, the EUR 7 462 (included in EUR 4 087 017) are subject to the approval of the Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL on plants obtained by certain new genomic techniques and their food and feed and amending Regulation (EU) 2017/625. Without these funds, the amount totals EUR 4 079 555.
For the 2025 estimate, the EUR 2 228 (included in EUR 4 018 897) were subject to the approval of the Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL on plants obtained by certain new genomic techniques and their food and feed and amending Regulation (EU) 2017/625. This approval did not occur therefore the revised estimate for 2025 amounts to EUR 4 016 669.

( 1 )
For the 2026 appropriations, the EUR 294 462 (included in EUR 69 453 482) are subject to the approval of the Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL on plants obtained by certain new genomic techniques and their food and feed and amending Regulation (EU) 2017/625. Without these funds, the amount totals EUR 69 159 020.
For the 2025 appropriations, the EUR 165 000 (included in EUR 66 992 482) were subject to the approval of the Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL on plants obtained by certain new genomic techniques and their food and feed and amending Regulation (EU) 2017/625. This approval did not occur therefore the revised appropriations for 2025 amount to EUR 66 827 482.
( 2 )
From 2025 Scientific Evaluation of Regulated products and Risk Assessment and Scientific Assistance are merged into a unique chapter.
( 3 )
For the 2026 appropriations, the EUR 557 118 in commitments (included in EUR 30 950 521) are subject to the approval of the Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL on plants obtained by certain new genomic techniques and their food and feed and amending Regulation (EU) 2017/625. Without these funds, the amount totals to EUR 30 393 403.
For the 2025 appropriations, EUR 251 138 in commitments and EUR (-81 772) in payment appropriations (included in EUR 33 775 715 and EUR 27 846 927 respectively) were subject to the approval of the Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL on plants obtained by certain new genomic techniques and their food and feed, and amending Regulation (EU) 2017/625 (proposal indicates EUR 405 000 of commitment appropriations (including EUR 165 000 for staff – Chapter 11) and EUR 81 000 in payment appropriations, to which the EFTA contribution of 2,75% is applied, i.e. EUR 11 138 in commitment appropriations and EUR 2 228 in payment appropriations) This approval did not occur therefore the revised appropriations for 2025 amount to EUR 33 524 577 and EUR 27 928 699 respectively.
( 1 ) All amounts in this budget document are expressed in euro unless otherwise indicated.
